title: optional.toResult(error) is the explicit conversion from absence to a typed Result failure
notes: specification/type-system.mdx, 'Optional': 'Optional absence MUST remain distinct from a Result error. Optional<T> MAY convert explicitly to Result<T, E> through toResult(error).' docs/DECISIONS.md 'Optionals and nullability' locks the same separation. The conversion being explicit is the promise: an implementation that let an absent Optional silently satisfy a Result contract would print something for line 2 other than the Missing message.
